critical_code_review_comments: server.py serve_media: correctly implements 206 with Content-Range, Accept-Ranges, immutable long-cache, and 416 on invalid range. In-memory _media_locks dict grows unbounded per unique path — minor; consider bounded LRU if traffic scales.

MEDIA_CACHE_DIR uses tempfile.gettempdir() which is per-container and per-restart — first hit after every pod restart re-downloads from object storage (acceptable trade-off since caching is a performance concern, not correctness).

Hero.jsx HERO_VIDEO is a hardcoded string constant not driven by site-content — inconsistent with HERO_IMG which uses read(content, 'landing.hero.image', <fallback>). Consider making video CMS-editable too for consistency.
No HEAD support on /api/media — HEAD returns 405. Some CDNs / preloaders send HEAD before GET; consider adding @api.head or a FastAPI 'methods=[GET, HEAD]' registration for robustness.

rca of the issue: The customer-assets kpwk8ol3 image URL renders on / but not on /supper-club/barsaat. Current Hero.jsx source has been rewritten to '/api/media/biraajo/media/4d82c167b3dc090f.jpg' as the fallback, and /api/site-content returns '/api/media/biraajo/media/6a6d9d936ab71fa4.jpg' for landing.hero.image. However, the shipped bundle.js at /static/js/bundle.js also does NOT contain the string — so the runtime source of the URL is elsewhere. The most likely explanation: the babel-loader cache (frontend/node_modules/.cache/babel-loader/*.json) still holds the OLD compiled Hero.jsx with the customer-assets fallback as HERO_IMG default. If webpack-dev-server is serving a chunk from that cache (or an HMR delta), the browser would evaluate the old fallback whenever content.landing.hero.image is transiently undefined during initial mount (before /api/site-content resolves).
